verdict.rationale: Persona documents headless operation through its backend-only Transactions API and API polling. Its sandbox mode and Simulate Actions allow programmatic integration testing without real verifications, which suits automated test runs. However, nothing documents CI pipeline usage, a CLI, or headless tooling built for CI, so the CI part of the story is only implied by the API and sandbox features. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, an official CLI or headless runner, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Transactions API | backend-only verification APIs, no Persona UI | Fully custom UI or backend-only verification flows

the following Simulate Actions can be specified to evoke Inquiry and Verification lifecycle behavior, thereby replicating the necessary conditions required for programmatically testing the behavior of your application.
Sandbox mode is provided so that you can test your integration without incurring any usage charges.
Poll the API for the latest inquiry statuses or fetch specific verification details without disrupting your primary integration.
A toggle is provided that allows you to force passes or force fails so that you can view and test all the possible states for your integration.
